method: Hypothetical nearest-core ecosystem areas; group mean upscaling
formula: Total t C = sum(cell area m2 * group mean kg C/m2)/1000
assumptions: Ecosystems are invented nearest-core zones, not mapped land cover. Four illustrative cores represent whole groups by assumption. Common depth 0–30 cm. Clipped cell areas exactly cover AOI; GeoTIFF boundary pixels are whole cells. No uncertainty or inventory accuracy is inferred.
